_meta.generated_from: module2_farmer_questionnaire_synthetic.csv (2A fields) + api/module2b_service.py rule tables (2B fields) + Module2_Orchestrator_Spec.md (score schema)
_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for Module 2A field options. Frontend dropdowns/checkboxes and backend input validation must both read from this file, not hardcode values independently.
_meta.note_on_no_fertilizer: Use the literal string 'No_Fertilizer' for the no-fertilizer case. Do NOT use 'None' -- it gets silently read as a missing value (NaN) by pandas on CSV load and will break inference.
changelog: v2.0: added 7 gourd-family crops (frontend-enabled, model-pending-retrain); added ph_value, soil_moisture_pct, light_intensity_lux as optional collected-but-unused-by-model fields.
v3.0: renamed to module2_field_options.json to reflect it now covers 2A input fields, 2B numeric fields, and the Module 2 orchestrator score schema — Module 2 is the only public endpoint.

v4.0: dataset regenerated with the 7 gourd-family/eggplant/cucumber crops (17,500 rows added via scripts/expand_crops.py, row_count 20000 -> 37500). Crops remain in added_pending_retrain until the model is actually retrained on the expanded dataset.

v5.0: model retrained (module2a-v2) on the expanded dataset with a leakage-safe grouped train/test split; all 15 crops moved to trained_and_supported after verifying the 7 new crops' macro-F1 tracks the original 8 rather than collapsing.

v6.0: model retrained (module2a-v4) -- crop-expansion resampling made dependency-aware (crop now realistically correlated with soil_type/irrigation_source/weather instead of independent of them), the previously-documented-but-unapplied cucurbit zinc/boron sensitivity prior was applied, and a new unsupervised IsolationForest anomaly/typicality detector was added (output field input_typicality, not a 7th risk target). See docs/MODEL_DOCUMENTATION.md (Training data).

v7.0: ph_value/soil_moisture_pct/light_intensity_lux changed from optional to REQUIRED (a soil meter is supplied with the deployment). Module 2 /predict is now implemented and orchestrates Module 2A + 2B; the temporary /dev/module2b/compare route has been removed per Module2_Orchestrator_Spec.md.

v8.0: model retrained as module2a-v5. The train/test split and hyperparameter-search CV now group rows by input signature only (all categorical inputs except crop, plus all symptom flags), so an identical input combination never appears on both sides of a split; the grouping columns are recorded as split_group_columns in models/module2a_schema.json. Input fields and the output contract are unchanged.

v9.0 (module 1.1.0): the Module 2 response adds recommendation_notes (farmer-facing notes, approved by the Project Manager on 2026-09-11). Input fields are unchanged. module2_orchestrator_output_schema now lists every response field.

v10.0 (module 1.2.0): two agronomy reviews (GG-M2-AR-01, GG-M2-AR-02) applied -- corrected pH/moisture ranges for chickpea/wheat/rice/maize/potato, crop-dependent overall_soil_health_score weighting for the 6 Cucurbitaceae crops and potato (see overall_soil_health_score.weights note below), a lab-soil-test recommendation on critical pH messages, and a plain-language rewrite of reliability_note. No field added, removed, or renamed.

ph_value.note: Required as of 2026-09-10: the deployment ships a soil meter with the farmer. Consumed by Module 2B (growing-conditions comparison) and by the Module 2 score. NOT part of Module 2A's trained feature vector.

soil_moisture_pct.note: Required as of 2026-09-10: the deployment ships a soil meter with the farmer. Consumed by Module 2B (growing-conditions comparison) and by the Module 2 score. NOT part of Module 2A's trained feature vector.

light_intensity_lux.note: Required as of 2026-09-10: the deployment ships a soil meter with the farmer. Consumed by Module 2B (growing-conditions comparison) and by the Module 2 score. NOT part of Module 2A's trained feature vector.

symptom_fields.mutually_exclusive_rule: If 'none_visible' is selected, all other symptom keys must be false. If any other symptom key is true, 'none_visible' must be false.

conditional_field_rules.rule: must equal 'not_applicable' when last_fertilizer_type == 'No_Fertilizer'; must NOT equal 'not_applicable' otherwise

crop_model_support.note: As of module2a-v5 (2026-09-10), all 15 crops are trained and supported by Module 2A and covered by Module 2B. The dataset is built by scripts/build_v4_dataset.py from data/module2_farmer_pre_crop_expansion.csv, and models are evaluated on a split grouped by input signature -- see docs/MODEL_DOCUMENTATION.md (Training data). api/schemas.py SUPPORTED_CROPS includes all 15.

module2_orchestrator_output_schema.note: Module 2 is the only public endpoint. It internally calls Module 2A and Module 2B and combines their outputs plus a computed score. See Module2_Orchestrator_Spec.md for full details.

response_fields.module2a: object: six *_risk entries {level: low|medium|high, confidence: 0-1}, overall_nutrient_health, input_typicality {anomaly_score, flag: typical|unusual}, model_version; null for an unsupported crop
response_fields.module2b: object: ph, soil_moisture, light -- each {current, ideal_range [low, high or null], gap, status: ok|moderate|critical}; ph also has nutrient_lockout_note; null for an unsupported crop
response_fields.recommendation_notes: object (see recommendation_notes below), or null for an unsupported crop
response_fields.message: string; present only when the crop is unsupported or Module 2B cannot serve it
response_fields.model_version: string, scoring-layer version; not present for an unsupported crop
response_fields.module2a_model_version: string, Module 2A model version; not present for an unsupported crop

recommendation_notes.headline: string
recommendation_notes.needs_attention: list of {nutrient, level, confidence_pct (integer), confidence_text, why}, worst first
recommendation_notes.soil_condition_note: string, present only when pH is outside the crop's ideal range
recommendation_notes.reliability_note: string, present only when module2a.input_typicality.flag is 'unusual'

overall_soil_health_score.weights_note: The table above is the default, used for 9 of the 15 crops. Two crop-dependent exceptions (see orchestrator_service.py CUCURBIT_SCORE_WEIGHTS / POTATO_SCORE_WEIGHTS, and Module2_Orchestrator_Spec.md Section 3): cucumber/bitter_gourd/snake_gourd/ridge_gourd/ash_gourd/bottle_gourd use nitrogen_risk=13, phosphorus_risk=13, potassium_risk=13, zinc_risk=8, boron_risk=8 (rest unchanged); potato uses nitrogen_risk=13, phosphorus_risk=13, potassium_risk=19 (rest unchanged). Both still sum to 100.
